enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Electron Burster
descriptions: Instant lightning attack fizzles against nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its phase maintains the recovered minimum range, publishes the fizzle when crowded, and otherwise fires the instant beam.

enemies.name: Toxiraptor
descriptions: Connected melee attacks can inject poison.
enemies.behavior: Every accepted surviving hit rolls the ranked chance and applies or refreshes the authored damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Quadrakiller
descriptions: Fires lightning-orb volleys and becomes exhausted briefly afterward.
enemies.behavior: Its recovered four-shot burst retains the long release/exhaustion interval before the next action.

enemies.name: Terrorsaur
descriptions: Throws a spread of fireballs that ignite heroes.
enemies.behavior: Ranked spread angles each resolve independently and accepted hits apply the burning damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Ray Killer
descriptions: Fires one fast horizontal piercing bolt per target in range and flees when struck.
enemies.behavior: A cast now targets every live hero or companion in range with its own piercing bolt, and an accepted incoming hit queues a navigation-clipped flee before the next volley.

enemies.name: Ghostly Tracker
descriptions: Has high dodge and damages every hero touched during its charge.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating participates in avoidance and its clipped through-target charge resolves every path contact.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Will stealth in an attempt to move in close.
Melee attacks cause the hero to become vulnerable to future physical damage.
enemies.behavior: Stealth Attack relocates into its target-relative band and chains Fear Nova; its ordinary melee applies the ranked charge-limited Physical Vulnerability modifier.

enemies.name: Molten Crawler
descriptions: Hurls magma at nearby heroes to create damaging lava pools and uses melee close up.
enemies.behavior: Its phase selects per-target retained lava pools or the recovered melee fallback.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.
enemies.behavior: It chooses the authored leap outside Swipe range and its persistent self-resurrection sign now consumes the first lethal hit, restores it at 40 percent health, and resumes combat once.

enemies.name: Dimensionist
descriptions: Creates a lasting sphere that slows heroes and projectiles, then calls debris down while protected.
enemies.behavior: Slow Shield uses a removable 16-second globe, Meteor flows into the authored 12-unit target-facing strafe, distant targets are pursued, and the intermediate range admits either packaged laugh/taunt animation.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow ranged projectiles and strafes sideways between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Ranked Poison Spit alternates with one bounded navigation-clipped lateral strafe or a short idle before the next attack.
